data.name: Yamraj
data.gender_notes: Yamraj is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The god of death; the restrainer
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root yam, 'to restrain' — Yama, the god of death. Its root is Sanskrit yam (यम्). Yama, the Hindu god of death. Yamraj is a Sanskrit name meaning “The god of death; the restrainer”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yamraj expresses “The god of death; the restrainer”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root yam, 'to restrain' — Yama, the god of death.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yamraj total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
